annotation.evidence_span: To handle cases where the receiver is only sending ACK frames, and hence will not receive acknowledgments for its packets, it MAY send a PING frame at most once per RTT to explicitly request acknowledgment.
annotation.interpretation_a: RTT refers to the round‑trip time measured by the sender, so the receiver may send a PING at most once per the sender’s RTT.
annotation.interpretation_b: RTT refers to the round‑trip time measured by the receiver, so the receiver may send a PING at most once per its own RTT.
annotation.justification: The clause references RTT without defining it, creating an incomplete constraint that allows two materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: Definition of RTT and how it is measured in this context (e.g., whether it is the sender’s or receiver’s RTT).
